description:
Fail-closed behaviour: whatever cannot be understood or used is masked, never sent. Shared vectors: the Python SDK is the source of truth and any other SDK runs the same file and must reproduce every expected value exactly. Each case is {name, op, input, expected}; op names one of the operations below. JSON bodies are source text, masked bodies are Python json.dumps text, and form and query output is urlencode(doseq=True) text; compare them as strings. A string of many equal characters is written {"$repeat": "a", "times": 65537}, and a string made of such parts {"$concat": [...]}; expand them before use.
Operations used in this file:
- apply_field_rules: input {field_rules, body, headers, query, content_type, project_defaults, salt, email_domain}; compile the field rules, then mask a request. project_defaults is null or {field_masks, regex_masks}, compiled as the project's extra rules. salt is the STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT string (null means unset). email_domain null means the default. expected {body, headers, query}, compared as exact text.
- apply_resp_field_rules: same input as apply_field_rules without query, plus resp_status (an integer or null); expected {body, headers}.
- compile_field_rules: input {field_rules}; expected the compiled sets as sorted lists: keep_body, keep_query, keep_header, keep_resp, keep_resp_header, keep_resp_status, mask_resp_status, keep_resp_header_status, mask_resp_header_status (the last four as [status, path] pairs sorted by status then path), and the objects body_mask_types, query_mask_types, resp_mask_types.
- compile_and_mask: input {field_masks, regex_masks, body, headers, query, content_type}; compile the two lists as the project's mask rules (any JSON, including malformed values), then mask_known. expected {rules: {unusable, field_masks (sorted), regex_replacements (the replacement text of each usable regex, in order)}, body, headers, query}.
- mask_all: input {body, headers, query, content_type}; expected {body, headers, query}.
- parse_form: input {body}; expected {result}: null for a body that is not key=value pairs, else the parsed {name: [values]}.
- extract_keypaths: input {body, content_type}; expected {key_paths}, the list of key paths in order.
- extract_value_types: input {body, content_type}; expected {value_types}.
- pipeline_process: input {polls, request, salt}; salt is the STUBSMITH_MASK_SALT string or null; build an empty rules cache and feed it each poll in order, as the answer of the sync endpoint ({status, body}: status 0 is a network error, body null when there is none), then process request ({method, url, req_headers, req_body, resp_status, resp_headers, resp_body}) unless it is null. expected {payload, cache}: payload is the whole payload without sdk_version (each SDK checks its own), or null; cache is {cursor, first_sync_done, project_defaults}, where project_defaults is null or {field_masks (sorted), regex_count, unusable}.
Not vectorised (each stays a test in its own repository):
- tests/test_pipeline.py::TestProjectDefaults::test_project_defaults_that_fail_to_compile_mask_kept_strings: patches compile_rules to raise
- tests/test_pipeline.py::TestPipelineFailClosed (3 tests) and tests/test_value_types.py::TestPipelineValueTypes::test_catastrophic_failure_returns_none: patch the masker or the URL parser to raise
- tests/test_pipeline.py::TestPipelineSyncNotFound::test_404_logs_one_warning_naming_404_and_backend_url and the three other 404 warning tests: assert on log records
- tests/test_pipeline.py::TestRulesCacheCursorAndTemplates::test_wait_for_first_sync_times_out_when_backend_unreachable: asserts on a timeout
- tests/test_pipeline.py::TestClientPipelineIntegration::test_privacy_init_failure_drops_capture_not_raw: patches the cache constructor and sends through a real client
- tests/test_privacy_modules.py::TestCompileRules::test_invalid_regex_warns_once: asserts on log records
- tests/test_privacy_modules.py::TestFreeTextFormBody::test_no_key_paths_value_types_or_value_pairs (the _extract_value_pairs assertion only; the key path and value type assertions are cases): calls a private helper that has no operation
- tests/test_first_sync_hold.py (8 tests): need threads, timing and a capture queue
- tests/test_capture.py::test_multipart_upload_records_type_but_no_fabricated_body and test_disabled_*: need a real HTTP exchange or the client options
- tests/test_replay.py::TestInstallInteraction (2 tests) and tests/test_cli.py::TestSummaryWarnings::test_degraded_stubs_surfaced: need the replay engine or the command line
